posts.zh:
dsh-interrupt-button 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0c0e5e19fcbce2738d02.html
posts.en:
dsh-interrupt-button is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0c0e5e19fcbce2738d02.html
